name: Auto Trainer
description: Decides whether this session is a bike ride or a row (there is no row lobby — the setup is) and makes Terra's auto-pair prefer the matching trainer: your bike trainer in bike mode, your rower in row mode (the Wi-Fi Kickr bridge stands down in row mode). Signals, in order: manual Mode setting → the Ride controller's state (out = bike, stowed = row) → the last-used trainer → bike. Pairing the other trainer once switches the default.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: auto = detect from the Ride controller's state (out = bike, stowed = row) and the last-used trainer. bike / row = force, no detection.

settings.label: Bike trainer name prefix
settings.description: Device names starting with this are preferred in bike mode. 'KICKR' covers both the Wi-Fi Kickr mock (KICKR Wi-Fi) and the Bluetooth Kickr Core (KICKR CORE xxxx).

settings.label: Rower name prefix
settings.description: Device names starting with this are preferred in row mode.
